entry.title: Cortisol Reactivity and Amygdala Connectivity in Chronic Stress
entry.summary: In a sample of N = 84 participants, cortisol reactivity correlated with amygdala-prefrontal connectivity (r = .32, p < .001; d = 0.45), suggesting a stable neuroendocrine marker of chronic stress vulnerability.

entry.title: A Meta-Analysis of Empathy Training Interventions
entry.summary: We synthesize findings across 12 randomized trials (total N = 1204) of empathy training programs, finding a small but reliable pooled effect (d = 0.28, p = 0.004) on self-reported affective empathy.
